_comment: The overlay's base image, read out of the container. Trials 1-2 were rewritten when createModuleBaseImage became createBaseImageFromContainer and the module stopped being the shape the function was built around; 4-6 cover the deployment-base rebase, which is the behaviour that moved out of MemoryFileSystem.rewriteLazy*Urls.
verify: cd host && npx vitest run test/module-base-image.test.ts >/dev/null 2>&1

trials.name: the window subtracts the header, as a body-holding backend would
trials.replace: return { baseImage, imageRead: (at, dest) => imageRead(at - 16, dest) };

trials.name: the lazy entries come back empty instead of from the container
the lazy half is read from the archive section
the deployment base is never applied, so a relative URL stays relative
the base is prepended to absolute and rooted URLs too
an archive rebases its transports but keeps its stale url
a module-built image's deferred files are reported as none
an archive member is mistaken for a standalone deferred file
the module is consulted even when the sections carry the answer
trials.scope: const fromModule = lazy === null && archives === null
trials.find: const fromModule = lazy === null && archives === null && moduleLazyEntries !== undefined

trials.name: the mount prefix is dropped, so the kernel manifest names the wrong tree
an archive with no declared mount prefix is accepted anyway
every member is filed under the first archive
the seal envelope is read as if it were the descriptor itself
an archive with no address is accepted, and mounts something that never activates
the address is read from the descriptor again instead of the field
the digest is dropped on the way back out
a standalone file's address comes back empty
